question: mobile-app (see ops/review/mobile-app.json)

claude.1: YES - a PWA with push can ship within days; a store app is possible but Apple review is the uncertain part.
claude.2: A first, then B for Google Play only if wanted: the PWA already installs, and web push gives the main thing an app adds (alerts) with no review or fees; a thin wrapper risks Apple's 4.2 rejection for little gain in 4 weeks.
claude.3: Web push needs a small always-on sender (e.g. a scheduled job with VAPID keys) since the site has no server, and iPhone users must add the site to the home screen first.
claude.4: Telegram already gives instant alerts to anyone, so an app mainly adds convenience, not new reach.
